description.value:
The same patience the drowned coastline had, waiting out every wall built against it. Nothing you do to a target is dramatic. It just, eventually, doesn't matter how hard they resist.

THE SLOW PULL — the ground drags like rising water — a target that fails its Fortitude save is slowed 1 for a minute, slowed 2 if it fails badly.

cinderfall.incomplete: This Aspect base feat plausibly wants a GrantItem granting its signature focus spell/ability, matching the ChoiceSet+GrantItem pattern already used for the Aspect subclass choice itself (reckoner.aspect.json). Not shipped: the only intra-corpus GrantItem precedents are a dynamic ChoiceSet-selection token or a fixed UUID into the real pf2e system's own compendiums -- there is no existing example of a fixed GrantItem pointing at another Cinderfall-authored card by literal compendium UUID, and the Cinderfall Foundry module's actual pack/document naming (tools/foundry/build_pack.py / pf2e-cinderfall-module) was not checked in this cards-only research pass. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md open question 1 (GRANTITEM-UUID-OPEN).
cinderfall.listing: Aspect Signatures / The Halving decay / entropy
